scope: Same-map project split; no unseen-map or unseen-object claim. Official train and seen-eval memberships are disjoint. Holdout raw episodes have not been reviewed by this agent.

selection_rule.demo: Minimum number of released evaluation rows, then lexicographic trajectory path. This is not a verified shortest flight.
selection_rule.remaining: Sort SHA256('vla-moderncitymap-project-splits-v1' + newline + trajectory path); first20development, next10holdout, remainderunassigned.

rules: All frames from an episode remain in one group.
Train membership does not certify that original model pretraining excluded holdout; this is an adaptation holdout from released seen-eval data.
No holdout labels or outcomes may enter correction training or checkpoint selection.
If holdout outcomes guide a model change, those episodes become development for that change.
Cleaned AeroVLA training JSON overlap remains unverified until its provenance is audited.
